correctness.rationale: The exact kernel norm and orthogonal projection identity reduce the full complex site/coefficient quantification to a compact radial scalar maximum; angular equalities are classified. The m=2 derivative gives one threshold. For each m>=3, the radial derivative has a single-hump polynomial-power factor, so exactly two (or zero) positive stationary roots and a sharp spinodal. Crossing F_a(x)=1 is equivalent to a>A(x); A diverges at both endpoints, and strict concavity of H(y) yields one and only one interior minimizer. This establishes the global center/orbit tie, unique branches, strict first-order switch and the fixed-beta asymptotics. Standalone standard-library checker passed 428 finite tests; it does not establish the infinite quantifiers.
